references.text: Barak is called from the territory of Issachar, confirming the tribe's role in the fight against Sisera.
Barak led the charge down into the valley, as described in the song.
The continuation of the criticism against Reuben, who stayed by his sheepfolds instead of joining the battle.
Jacob's blessing over Issachar describes the tribe's character and territory.
Jacob's prophecy concerning Reuben, who lost his birthright due to instability, which is reflected in Reuben's hesitation.
Moses' blessing over Issachar mentions the tribe's participation in battle.
The tribe of Reuben chose to settle east of the Jordan, which may explain their absence from the fight.
